patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column content blocks are frequently used, pairing text with illustrative graphics or images, often with the graphic element slightly overlapping or breaking the container boundary.
A vibrant, multi-color accent palette (green, blue, pink, yellow) is used for interactive elements and illustrations, contrasting sharply with a predominantly white, black, and gray base.
Major content sections and feature blocks are presented within large, rounded-corner card-like containers, creating a soft, approachable feel and clear visual separation.

Interactive, illustrative elements (like graphs and geometric puzzles) appear dynamic, suggesting subtle animations or state changes to explain concepts, while testimonials are presented in a scrollable carousel.

technique_notes: Content sections are often designed with a split layout, featuring text on one side and a visually engaging illustration or image on the other, contained within large, rounded-corner cards.

Dynamic, illustrative elements are likely animated using canvas or CSS keyframes to demonstrate concepts and enhance engagement. Content carousels, likely powered by Swiper, are used for managing testimonial displays. The main header is not sticky and scrolls out of view with the page content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, sans-serif headings (approx. 3-4x body text) with clear hierarchy, complemented by legible body text and smaller, lighter sub-labels.
design_tokens.radius: rounded — consistently applied to content blocks, buttons, and image containers.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — generous padding around content blocks and between sections, creating a sense of openness.

standout: The site's distinctive use of playful, interactive-looking illustrations that visually explain complex educational concepts makes the content highly engaging and approachable. This is combined with a clean, modern layout and a vibrant accent palette that feels fresh and inviting, setting it apart from typical educational platforms.
